name: Bronwen Davies
bio:
Bronwen Davies is a highly experienced logistics coordinator who brings a steady hand to the fast-paced world of motorsport. Born and raised in Cardiff, Wales, Bronwen's passion for racing ignited during her teenage years, spending weekends at local rally events. She initially pursued a career in supply chain management, honing her organizational skills in the manufacturing sector before making the leap to motorsport. 

Joining Team Penske a decade ago, Bronwen has become an invaluable asset, ensuring the smooth and timely delivery of equipment and personnel to race events across the globe. Her meticulous planning, proactive problem-solving, and calm demeanor under pressure have earned her the respect of her colleagues. Bronwen prides herself on her ability to anticipate logistical challenges and implement effective solutions, keeping the team running like clockwork. Her flexible approach and dedication to her work have been instrumental in the team's success.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled in a practical bob
physical.description: Bronwen is a woman of average height with a warm smile and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn copy of the Ordnance Survey map of Wales.
Insists on having a cup of strong Welsh tea before every major race.
Uses motorsport jargon in everyday conversations, often to humorous effect.
